notes: Data-driven Secure Apps registry. No field here is ever executed as a shell command: 'executable' and 'arguments' are separate and both validated (Scripts/secure_apps/sa_config.py). Payload paths must resolve inside managed_root and may not cross a reparse point; 'mount_path' is the one declared path outside it, because that is where the protected filesystem appears. Conditions are typed entries from a fixed table - there is no policy scripting language. Managed payload (apps, vaults, state) is excluded from Git and AUDAPACK.

profiles.label: Obsidian
profiles.notes: Reference profile. The vault mounts back onto its historical plaintext path so existing Obsidian references keep working; the plaintext tree is NOT deleted by migration. authentication.user_verification is 'required' on purpose: this profile exists so that possession of the YubiKey alone is not enough to read the vault, which means FIDO2 PIN (or built-in biometric verification) on every enrollment and every unlock. Enrollment refuses outright if the authenticator has no user verification configured. First-run enrollment builds the container at <container dir>\_enrollment_mount and never at mount_path, so it can run while the plaintext vault still occupies that path.
